newsitem.title: USA: FirstFederal to acquire Summit stock.
newsitem.headline: FirstFederal to acquire Summit stock.

text.p: FirstFederal Financial Services Corp and Summit Bancorp, whose shares trade publicly on pink sheets, said Tuesday they signed a definitive agreement for FirstFederal to acquire Summit's stock.
Under the terms of the agreement, FirstFederal will exchange 1.87 shares of its common stock for each of the 234,916 shares of Summit stock, the companies said in a joint press release.
Based on the average of FirstFederal's closing bid and asking price of $39.375 on December 30, the transaction is valued at about $17.3 million, the companies said.

The merger, which will be accounted for as a pooling of interests, is expected to close in the third quarter of 1997, pending Summit shareholder approval, regulatory approval and other closing conditions.

Summit Bancorp, based in Akron, Ohio, reported net income of $600,000 for the first nine months of 1996 with an annualized return on assets of 1.03 percent and an annualized return on shareholders' equity of 11.72 percent.
